Willowman forces a morale check on normally immune creatures - even undead must roll.

GMs: Use Willowman to force a morale check on level 2 undead, breaking their immunity and shifting the fight.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Reef Shark's Pack Tactics often surprises parties - advantage triggers when an ally is within 5 feet.

DMs: Maintain the sharks' 5-foot adjacency for Pack Tactics advantage; players, break their formation to negate it.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Weapon-breaker does more than just damage - it destroys the opponent's weapon on a crit.

Judges: Time Weapon-breaker's crit to destroy a key opponent's weapon, turning their advantage into a liability.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Advantage and Disadvantage confuse players - they never stack.

GMs: Remind them advantage and disadvantage don't stack; one cancels the other, leaving a single roll.

Daily tabletop RPG rulings. Follow @bizzalgames70 for one a day.

Way of the Astral Self transitions from setup to closer - Arms of the Astral Self cost 1 ki to summon and use.

DMs: Remind your Astral Self monk to spend 1 ki on spectral arms early to maximize their Wisdom-based reach and control.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

The Funnel has a high mortality rate - most 0-level characters die before reaching 1st level.

Judges: Remind them that their 1d4 HP peasants survive The Funnel by using their wits, not by rolling high on stats.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Give Roper a real price.

GMs: Make them roll DC 15 Strength checks early or watch them get dragged into a 2d8 bite.

Bookmark it before your players find the loophole. @bizzalgames70

Knocking out a Creature is more flexible than most players realize - you can choose to reduce a creature to 1.

DMs: Remind players they can leave foes at 1 HP and unconscious with melee attacks to avoid unnecessary deaths.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Whirling Doom often surprises clerics with its encounter-altering potential - 1 round per level of razor.

Judges: Cast Whirling Doom when foes are 50' away, blocking their path with a razor barrier for 1 round per level.

Save this for your next session. Daily rulings: @bizzalgames70

Ghosts often create unexpected time pressure - Etherealness and Horrific Visage force costly decisions each.

DMs: Set a 5-minute timer each round to remind players of the Ghost's Etherealness and Horrific Visage impact.

One ruling a day, no fluff. Follow @bizzalgames70.

Gauntlets Of Might alter your Strength stat - it becomes 18 (+4) while worn.

GMs: Hand out Gauntlets Of Might when players face a challenge needing Strength 18, not as everyday gear.

Send this to the rules-lawyer in your group. @bizzalgames70

Judges: exploit Zamyra's 160' fly speed to outmaneuver the party, forcing them to adapt or suffer.
